requirements.text: A bachelor’s degree or higher and at least three years of professional experience in software development, infrastructure, or developer tooling roles.
Demonstrated coding proficiency and problem-solving skills, with experience in Linux environments.
Experience working with or building integrations for IDEs, CI/CD systems, version control platforms, or developer productivity tools.
Understanding of AI technologies and an interest in incorporating AI tooling in developer workflows.
Solid collaboration and communication skills, with experience working directly with users or stakeholders to deliver solutions.
A genuine interest in improving the developer experience, with a track record of thinking carefully about what makes engineers productive.
